Chapter 521: Chapter 16: Crystal of Chaos (Please Subscribe)

“The Galaxy Master is paying attention to us?”

The invincibles of the Eighth Layer on the human side were certainly concerned.

Like Battlefield B0001, every moment was observed by human Ninth Rank or even Tenth Rank Evolvers.

But such attention was merely that, attention.

To maintain the intensity of the war, even if the human side was suffering a great defeat, Ninth Rank and Tenth Rank Evolvers would not step in.

The Tianyu Clan would do likewise, with their own Ninth Rank and Tenth Rank strongmen watching over this place.

...

The outcome of conflicts on Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefields was essentially unrelated to the Ninth Rank, as they would not personally interfere in the battle dynamics.

But the attention of the Galaxy Master…

The Galaxy Master was not of the Ninth Rank; his attention was indeed a real boost for the human side.

With the strength of the Galaxy Master, his involvement would inevitably lead to a reversal of the situation.

“Where is the Galaxy Master?”

“When did the Galaxy Master arrive at the battlefield? I wasn’t aware.”

“Nonsense, the Galaxy Master is our human side’s Sea-Calming Divine Needle; probably only the Baiyun Lord knows his whereabouts.”

…

Dozens of Eighth Rank invincibles discussed in low voices, their mood visibly relaxed.

Before today, the Baiyun Lord had never revealed any news about the Galaxy Master, almost leading them to think that the invitation had encountered some problems.

“Even with the Galaxy Master here, we shouldn’t let our guard down,”

The Baiyun Lord reminded, glancing at the many Eighth Layer invincible Evolvers.

The Galaxy Master was their trump card, their weapon.

But everything couldn’t just rely on the Galaxy Master.

If in this war, their human side was initially crushed by the Tianyu Clan,

then how useful would the Galaxy Master be, however strong? Was he expected to take on all the Eighth Layer invincibles of the Tianyu Clan on this battlefield alone?

After reminding the Eighth Layer invincible Evolvers, the Baiyun Lord silently thought to himself: “I wonder where the Galaxy Master is right now.”

In fact, he knew very little about the Galaxy Master, only that, two years ago, he had received a message from him.

It mentioned that he had arrived and would intervene at a critical moment.

As for more, there was nothing.

The Baiyun Lord also dared not disturb Lin Yuan.

…

On the other side of Battlefield B0001.

A group of Eighth Layer invincibles from the Tianyu Clan stood in the void.

Leading them was an elder with six pairs of wings on his back, whose gaze was cold and aura daunting.

The hierarchy within the Tianyu Clan was clear, with one’s future potential and heights locked in from birth.

Those in the Tianyu Clan with a pair of wings were of mediocre talent, and their heights in life would be at the First or Second Layer.

Two pairs of wings, their future achievements would be at least the Third Layer.

Three pairs of wings, their potential would not fall below the Fifth Layer.

Four pairs of wings, they could hope to reach the Seventh Layer.

…

The wings on the back of the Tianyu Clan contained many incredible abilities, almost like some special life ‘talents’.

It was precisely for this reason that the Tianyu Clan was among the universe’s peak clans, far surpassing human civilization in quantity,

but their average level was far inferior to the Insect Race,

The number of the Insect Race was actually quite rare, and the vast majority were batch-produced Insect Race Warriors.

Each Insect Race Hive was a war machine, and as long as resources were sufficient, they could truly be invincible at their tier.

“Leader, the number of Eighth Layer invincibles on the human side has not increased,” a Five-Winged Sky Feather Clansman spoke softly.

“Oh?”

The Six-Winged Elder raised his eyebrows.

“It seems that the human civilization is hiding other backups,” the Six-Winged Elder said.

The Tianyu Clan and human civilization had been fighting for many years and knew that the latter would not be unprepared,

even as they took advantage of human civilization’s inability to support itself in time by launching a comprehensive battle.

But if they really felt there was no chance of victory, they would surely back down voluntarily to avoid further losses.

After all, a mere Medium-Sized Battlefield’s outcome, given the scale of human civilization, would not be taken too seriously.

If the humans now dared to engage actively, it indicated they definitely had a critical trump card—and this trump card was powerful enough that the humans didn’t believe they would necessarily lose.

“Exactly, according to our Think Tank’s analysis of this war, there are three possibilities for the actions of human civilization today,” the Five-winged Tianyu Clan Strongman spoke up: “First, human civilization Evolvers have obtained a Ninth Rank or Tenth Rank Secret Treasure capable of changing the course of battle.”

“Ninth Rank, Tenth Rank Secret Treasure?” the Six-Winged Elder shook his head slightly.

Normally, the Eighth Layer invincibles who dared appear on a battlefield, whether they were human Evolvers or Tianyu Clan strongmen, would not carry overly precious treasures.

While invincibles of the Eighth Layer were difficult to kill elsewhere, on Different Species Battlefields, especially on ancient ones like Battlefield B0001, the mortality rate was still quite high.

The environment of the Otherworldly Battlefield was unique, and coupled with many same-tier strongmen, invincibles of the Eighth Layer could easily falter.

If an avatar died, for an Eighth Layer invincible, that would already be a significant loss, but if the avatar was carrying a valuable treasure… it would be catastrophic.

Ninth Rank, Tenth Rank Secret Treasures were highly valuable and, while they could significantly enhance the combat power of the Eighth Layer invincibles, if an Eighth Layer invincible bearing such artifacts perished, those treasures could end up in the enemy’s hands.

Thus, unless absolutely necessary, neither human civilization Evolvers nor Tianyu Clan strongmen would use such artifacts.

However, this war found human civilization already at a absolute disadvantage, so according to the analysis of the Tianyu Clan’s Think Tank, it was possible that this might occur.
